maira2_grounded_report.description: args={}. Single verified frontal CXR only: MAIRA-2 grounded findings report with original-image coordinates. Lateral, non-CXR or unknown view returns not_applicable. Report and boxes are one fallible model output, not independent evidence; no history or extra images are supplied.

xray_phrase_grounding.description: args={"phrase":"specific finding"}. Verified frontal CXR phrase localization, original-image normalized coordinates. Fallible same-MAIRA evidence: box presence is not disease proof and no box does not exclude disease. Lateral/unknown/non-CXR is not_applicable. 300-token original limit with inherited EOS guard, no output repair.

roi_crop.description: args={"box":[x0,y0,x1,y1],"zoom":2}. Explicit original-image normalized coordinates, top-left origin, x right/y down; zoom1-4, output side<=4096. Returns untouched original, full marked context, enlarged crop to main model. Use original/image coordinates, not MAIRA center-crop coordinates. Interpolation adds no acquired detail; screen side is not patient side. Other model tools always process original image; ROI is not rebound as tool input.

medret.description: For a specific medical knowledge gap only. args={"query":"focused clinical concept","top_k":3}. Never search for the benchmark question, case ID, or its answer options.

reflect.description: Mid-process critique for a concrete conflict or evidence gap. args={"reasoning":"current hypothesis, conflict or gap, and evidence"}.

verify.description: Use before finalizing when a concrete unresolved risk warrants another check. args={"proposed_answer":"candidate answer","risk":"concrete uncertainty or conflict"}. This tool sees all original images and options and prior retrieved evidence for this case. Change the answer only when the audit identifies specific supporting evidence.
